due_query_errors.query: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM provisiond.operations o WHERE o.id IN (SELECT id FROM (WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,updated_at FROM provisiond.operations WHERE status IN ('succeeded','failed')) SELECT c.id FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.resource_id,max(r.expires_at) AS expires_at FROM provisiond.idempotency_records r JOIN candidates c ON c.id=r.resource_id WHERE r.resource_kind='operation' GROUP BY r.resource_id) r ON r.resource_id=c.id WHERE (r.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND r.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()) OR (r.resource_id IS NULL AND c.updated_at<statement_timestamp()-$1::bigint*interval '1 second')) due) RETURNING o.id,o.tenant_id,o.created_at,o.updated_at) INSERT INTO provisiond.retired_operations(id,tenant_id,created_at,retained_until) SELECT o.id,o.tenant_id,o.created_at,COALESCE((SELECT max(expires_at) FROM provisiond.idempotency_records r WHERE r.resource_kind='operation' AND r.resource_id=o.id),o.updated_at+$1::bigint*interval '1 second') FROM removed o RETURNING id
